- **Stages 1–3 are ticked and stamped COMPLETE.** The stamps are authoritative, so there's nothing to cross-check against `specs/plans/completed/`.
- **Stage 3 (plan 5) is the only stamp no entry cites yet.** Its `## Handoff to later stages` reads `None`, so it amends nothing. Its stamp correctly omits the Handoff sentence.
- **Plans 2 and 3's Handoffs are already cited** in Stage 2 and Stage 3's `Consumes`.
- **No unticked stages remain**, and this roadmap has no Ranked list. There is nothing to amend, nothing to hand off and nothing to commit.

Every stage is ticked, so the next step is the **roadmap-completion review** (§6). This is a conformance audit of the accumulated system against R1–R6, with evidence per verdict. It is not a code-diff review, because each stage was reviewed when it merged.

## Running the audit (read-only)

```
Read  specs/parking-occupancy-spec.md                         # R1–R6 text, §2–§4
Read  specs/plans/completed/2-sensor-ingest.md                # Deviation notes, esp. R3 cadence
Read  specs/plans/completed/3-occupancy-rates.md
Read  specs/plans/completed/5-occupancy-dashboard.md
Read  specs/deferred_items.md                                 # if present: unticked entries from these stages
Read  sensors/poll.py                                         # R3: was 15-min polling at derivation; confirm now 5 min
Grep  "bay_events" --type py                                  # R1/R2 loader + dedup
Grep  "duplicate|dedup|ON CONFLICT|unique" --type py --type sql
Grep  "occupancy" --type py --type sql                        # R4 computation, 15-min slots
Grep  "0\.95|95" --glob "**/{alert,alerts,dashboard}*"        # R5/R6 dashboard + threshold
Glob  tests/**/*.py                                           # tests backing each Exit
```

I'll fill in one rubric row per requirement, citing `path:line`, the implementing plan and any Deviation note. **R3** gets a specific check: the original gap was 15-minute polling against §2's 5 minutes, and Stage 1's Exit claims 5 minutes now holds.

## What comes after the audit

- **If every requirement is met:** I'll ask you to approve retirement. That means moving this roadmap and `specs/parking-occupancy-spec.md` to `specs/completed/` and committing on `main`. I won't move anything before you say yes.
- **If any requirement is unmet:** I'll bring each one to you as a single question. It either becomes a new stage, which keeps the roadmap live, or it's deferred with a written reason.
